headline: Fix #2 (DB KDS index, ca5629658) introduced a P0/P1 regression: the KDS board query throws SQLSTATE[42S22] over HTTP because the raw FORCE INDEX FROM expression collides with BranchScope's table-qualified branch_id. The kitchen display shows 'Aucune commande en cours' (0 orders) for every real staff/admin user despite 42 active orders. Tests are green because the FORCE INDEX path is MySQL-gated and unexercised in CI. The other 3 fixes hold and no other surface regressed (caisse/fiscal + borne healthy).
recommended_fix_direction: Do NOT replace the table name via ->from(DB::raw(...)) when BranchScope (or any qualified-column predicate) is active. Options: (a) apply the index hint via a raw ORDER BY / from with the SAME identifier 'orders' so qualification still resolves (i.e. ensure BranchScope's $builder->getQuery()->from stays a bare 'orders'); (b) use an index hint mechanism that does not overwrite the from-identifier; (c) add a MySQL-backed feature test with actingAs(branchStaff) that exercises the KDS board endpoint over the real request lifecycle (BranchScope active) so the collision is caught by CI.
